verdict.rationale: Box documents first-party natural-language capabilities. The Box AI API lets you ask questions, summarize, extract and generate over content. The hosted MCP server at mcp.box.com lets AI agents search and use Box files, so a user can work with Box through an agent's natural-language interface. However, the evidence covers mainly querying and using content, not operating the product broadly (sharing, permissions, admin actions) through NL commands. missing for 10: documented NL control of core actions such as sharing, collaboration, uploads and folder management; a native in-product NL command interface; independent or hands-on corroboration.
